about.label: The Firm
about.title: A heritage of legal excellence since 1987
about.description: Founded by Me Coffi Alexis AQUEREBURU, our firm has established itself as a reference in business law in West Africa and internationally. Our ISO 9001:2015 certification demonstrates our commitment to quality and rigor in every case.

expertise.title: Our areas of expertise
expertise.subtitle: Comprehensive legal support covering all aspects of business law in Africa and internationally
expertise.piDesc: Trademark, patent and copyright protection. Anti-counterfeiting. Accredited agents with the African Intellectual Property Organization.
expertise.affairesDesc: Supporting businesses across 17 OHADA countries. Corporate law, commercial contracts, mergers & acquisitions and restructuring.
expertise.fiscalDesc: Tax advisory, tax review, optimization, litigation. Banking and financial expertise. Audit and tax compliance in the WAEMU zone.
expertise.maritimeDesc: Maritime litigation, cargo transport, marine insurance. Recognized expertise along West African coasts.
expertise.environnementDesc: Environmental law and taxation. Supporting businesses in environmental compliance and sustainable development.
expertise.penalDesc: Employment law, labor disputes, white-collar crime. Defending the interests of businesses and individuals.
expertise.formationsDesc: Continuing education in OHADA law, taxation, digital judicial transformation. Seminars for businesses and legal professionals.
